name: Tremp (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with three white fleurs-de-lis arranged as a bunch of lilies, one above and two below.
history: The official flag of Tremp is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with three white fleurs-de-lis, each of height and width 1/3 of the height of the cloth, juxtaposed at their lower lateral ends with the central fleur-de-lis pointing upward, a simplified sign of the bunch of lilies of the arms. The arms were approved on 24 April 1989 and the flag officially on 3 October 1989, published in the DOGC.

features.role: three fleurs-de-lis juxtaposed at their lower ends, the central one pointing upward
